propositions: Cloud Jira descriptions and comments must encode Markdown as structured ADF instead of plain-text paragraphs during reconciliation
Data Center Jira descriptions and comments must render Markdown as native wiki markup instead of literal source, with safe-unit segmentation and fallback on pandoc failure or absence

Bidirectional sync must suppress redundant echo-driven updates via per-binding baselines, change-gated hashing, and three-way comparison while preserving Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) through origin gating
Comment synchronization must use append-only local-comment-key to Jira-comment-ID mappings and route comments through the same rich-text codec as descriptions without supporting edit or delete

DC corpus must exhibit zero monotonic length decay over five repeated render passes and Cloud corpus must reach 99%+ idempotent Markdown-to-ADF round-trip fixed points, both measured over committed stratified fixture sets

Concurrent local and remote edits must emit conflict flags instead of silent overwrites, unchanged reconcile passes must add zero committed-state entries, and Jira-authored constructs must survive the next rebar-sourced reconcile pass
